title: Python Classes
description: Python is an object oriented programming language. Almost everything in Python is an object.

challenges.title: Create Class
challenges.exercise: Create a class named 'MyClass' with a property 'x = 5'.

challenges.title: Create Object
challenges.exercise: Create an object of MyClass named 'p1' and print p1.x.
challenges.solution:
class MyClass:
  x = 5

p1 = MyClass()
print(p1.x)

challenges.title: init Method
challenges.exercise: Create a class 'Person' with __init__ taking 'name'. Print Person('Aris').name.

challenges.title: Object Methods
challenges.exercise: Add a method 'greet' to Person that prints 'Hi ' + name. Call it.

challenges.title: Inheritance
challenges.exercise: Create a class 'Student' that inherits from 'Person'. Print 'Inherited'.
